description: Fires in the opening (roughly ply <= 12) when I (the player to move) own the bottom-right corner (row 0, col 6) with no opponent stone stacked above it, and the opponent has stones on the bottom two rows in columns 0, 1, 3, 4 or 5. Stronger with more such opponent stones and fewer moves played; opponent stones in column 2 and my own stones in columns 4-5 weaken it. Without my corner stone it essentially never fires.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.01 on 4 positions.
notes: Layer 0 board-position feature. p1 (corner mine & ply<=9) F1 .571; hand-weighted p3 .607; final p7 (corner gate, col-6 opponent penalty, per-column opponent weights rows 0-1, ply decay, ply<=12) F1 .679, P .73 R .64, AUROC .815, sim share .32. Minimal pairs agree on the corner gate, col-6 opponent kill, col-2 penalty. Rare late-game firings (ply 20+) unexplained. Steering effect nil. Weights are hand-set from act probes, not fit.
